user.description: Gas meter, invoices and payments from ebok.myorlen.pl.

data_description.auth_method: How you log in at ebok.myorlen.pl: eBOK login and password, or the ORLEN ID account (it may send an SMS code).

error.invalid_auth: eBOK rejected the login or password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach eBOK. Try again later.
error.mfa_invalid: Wrong code. Enter the latest SMS code.
error.mfa_expired: The SMS step expired. Log in again.

abort.no_meters: The account has no gas meter.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different eBOK account.

data_description.update_interval: How often eBOK is polled. Invoices and payment states change at most a few times a day.

add_reading.name: Submit meter reading
add_reading.description: Sends the gas meter reading to eBOK, like the website's reading form. Orlen bills from this value - check it against the meter.

value.name: Reading
value.description: Meter state in m³, whole units as on the meter.

meter_reset.name: Meter replaced
meter_reset.description: Allow a value lower than the last reading (new or rolled-over meter).

confirm_large_increase.name: Confirm large increase
confirm_large_increase.description: Allow a value much higher than the last reading.

not_a_meter.message: The device is not a myORLEN eBOK meter.

not_loaded.message: The meter's account is not loaded.

reading_lower.message: {value} m³ is lower than the last reading ({last} m³). If the meter was replaced, set meter_reset.

reading_too_high.message: {value} m³ is more than {limit} m³ above the last reading ({last} m³). If correct, set confirm_large_increase.

auth_failed.message: The eBOK login is no longer valid; log in again.
